scope: Local Atlas only; Google Maps reference agreement, not independently surveyed correctness
rubric: Compare with full Google listing. Ignore casing, abbreviations, transliteration and district formatting. Require matching street/number (including a containing number range) or the named premise. A conflicting named facility is not a full match even at the same street number. Missing floor/shop is not penalized. Distinct letter suffixes remain distinct. Missing candidates fail address agreement. These manual judgements and possible alternate/corner addresses remain reviewable below.
